description: Provenance of the frozen CrystalCall tool corpus. The corpus itself lives under experiments/vendor/ (gitignored) and is rebuilt with the command below; every corpus input is local, so no download is involved.
id_derivation: sha256 of canonical-JSON {kind, sorted [name, sha256] entries, extra} truncated to 16 hex chars; see src/crystalcall/snapshots.py
note: Snapshot ids are content-derived, so they change whenever this repository's src/ or docs/ change or the interpreter's stdlib changes. The authoritative ids for a given build are in experiments/vendor/corpus/CORPUS_MANIFEST.json.

vendored_binaries.fetch_command: curl -fsSL https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/releases/download/14.1.1/ripgrep-14.1.1-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz -o /tmp/rg.tar.gz && sha256sum /tmp/rg.tar.gz  # expect c827481c4ff4ea10c9dc7a4022c8de5db34a5737cb74484d62eb94a95841ab2f && tar -xzf /tmp/rg.tar.gz -C /tmp && install -Dm755 /tmp/ripgrep-14.1.1-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/rg experiments/vendor/bin/rg
vendored_binaries.note: experiments/vendor/ is gitignored; this record is the committed provenance for the binary. Resolution order at runtime: $CRYSTALCALL_RG, then PATH, then this vendored binary.
